title: EvolvingBrain: An Adaptive Skill System for Multi-modal Agents Self-Evolution in Open Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2610.20786v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-modal agents have made significant progress in interacting with open worlds. However, their ability to self-evolve remains limited. Supervised fine-tuning enables imitation but not active experience organization, while outcome-based reinforcement learning promotes exploration yet underuses intermediate trajectory information. Therefore, we propose EvolvingBrain, which uses an adaptive skill system as the brain for agent self-evolution, consisting of two following components. Stratified Skill Self-Evolution: extracts Procedural Patterns and Problematic Patterns from model-specific trajectories, summarizes experience by generating skills, and evolves through multiple interactions with the open world, ultimately forming a Stratified Skill Architecture consisting of Domain, Plan, and Action/Trap Skills, which provides the agent with a multi-granularity knowledge repository and a novel evolution approach. translated_title: EvolvingBrain：面向开放世界中多模态智能体自我进化的自适应技能系统
translated_abstract: 多模态智能体在与开放世界的交互中已取得显著进展，但其自我进化能力仍然有限。监督微调能够实现模仿，却无法主动组织经验；而基于结果的强化学习虽然促进了探索，却未能充分利用中间轨迹信息。为此，我们提出EvolvingBrain，它以自适应技能系统作为智能体自我进化的大脑，包含以下两个组件。分层技能自我进化：从模型自身的轨迹中提取程序性模式与问题性模式，通过生成技能来总结经验，并在与开放世界的多次交互中持续进化，最终形成由领域技能、规划技能和动作/陷阱技能构成的分层技能架构，为智能体提供一个多粒度知识库和一种全新的进化方式。状态感知自适应执行：（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出EvolvingBrain，一种以自适应技能系统为大脑的多模态智能体自我进化框架，通过分层技能自我进化形成领域、规划与动作/陷阱技能架构，并结合状态感知的自适应执行，克服了监督微调无法主动组织经验、结果导向强化学习浪费中间轨迹信息的局限。
en_tdlr: EvolvingBrain is an adaptive skill system serving as the brain for multi-modal agents' self-evolution in open worlds, combining stratified skill self-evolution (forming a Domain, Plan, and Action/Trap skill architecture) with state-aware adaptive execution to overcome the limitations of supervised fine-tuning and outcome-based reinforcement learning.
